year_to_expense = {}

# Fill only Lookup!B2:B12 with literal results; unmatched years get an empty string.

    year_cell = ws_lookup.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    
    # Evaluate the simple year progression formulas in column A if present (e.g. =A3+1).
    if isinstance(year_cell, str) and year_cell.startswith('=A') and year_cell.endswith('+1'):
        prev_year = ws_lookup.cell(row=row-1, column=1).value
        if isinstance(prev_year, str) and prev_year.startswith('=A') and prev_year.endswith('+1'):
            # Since A2 is 2007 and the formulas increment by 1 each row
            year = 2007 + (row - 2)
        else:
            year = prev_year + 1 if isinstance(prev_year, (int, float)) else None
    else:
        year = int(year_cell) if isinstance(year_cell, (int, float)) else None
    
    ws_lookup.cell(row=row, column=2).value = year_to_expense.get(year, "")

wb.save(output_path)

# Verification
